name: Nicole
title: Clamor Within
description: Nicole Reeyn is a voiceless angel and member of the Hexenzirkel, also known by the codename N.

skillTalents.name: Allegoria
skillTalents.description: Normal Attack: Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Pyro DMG. Charged Attack: Consumes Stamina to deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time. Plunging Attack: Plunges from mid-air, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Pyro DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Revelation: Uncreated Light
skillTalents.description: Bestows Grace of Kenosis on nearby party members, increasing their ATK, dealing AoE Pyro DMG, and creating a Shield of Blazing Light. The shield's DMG absorption is based on Nicole's ATK and absorbs Pyro DMG with extra effectiveness.

skillTalents.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent
skillTalents.description: Deals AoE Pyro DMG and switches Nicole to Silent Contemplation. While active, nearby active party members who hit opponents can summon Arcane Projections that perform coordinated attacks dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the active character's corresponding Elemental Type.

passiveTalents.name: Methexis
passiveTalents.description: For 20s after using Revelation: Uncreated Light, Nicole observes other active party members. After an observed character stays on field for 3s, or immediately if they are a Hexerei character, Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis and grants additional ATK.

passiveTalents.name: Philokalia
passiveTalents.description: When Elemental DMG from nearby active party members hits an opponent, Nicole's own Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis for 8s.

passiveTalents.name: Light in the Darkness
passiveTalents.description: After completing Witch's Homework: The Role of a Guide...?, Nicole becomes a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, Hexerei: Secret Rite increases the DMG dealt by Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections by 300% of Nicole's ATK.

passiveTalents.name: Nepsis
passiveTalents.description: When in Teyvat and not in combat, Nicole's Charged Attack becomes Emissarial Guidance if the current region's Treasure Compass has been obtained, calling upon nearby Seelie to guide the way with a Treasure Compass-like effect.

constellations.name: Do Not Be Afraid, Child Who Is Loved
constellations.description: When the current active party character hits an opponent, summons an additional Arcane Projection: Unity coordinated attack that deals AoE Elemental DMG of that character's corresponding Elemental Type.

constellations.name: I Will Guide You and Show You the Path You Should Tread
constellations.description: Enhances Revelation: Uncreated Light. Grace of Kenosis increases ATK by an additional amount, Guidance of Theosis decreases nearby opponents' corresponding Elemental RES, and nearby active party members gain Shield of Blazing Light.

constellations.name: A Lamp by Your Side, A Light to Shine the Way
constellations.description: Increases the Level of Revelation: Uncreated Light by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Whether Left or Right, No Matter Which Way You Turn
constellations.description: When nearby party members upgrade Grace of Kenosis to Guidance of Theosis, Nicole grants Pathfinder's Blessing, increasing their attack talent and elemental talent DMG based on Nicole's ATK for a limited number of hits.

constellations.name: You Will Hear My Voice Beside You
constellations.description: Increases the Level of Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: This Is the Path, Walk It Without Delay
constellations.description: When Nicole's Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis, all nearby party members' Grace of Kenosis also upgrades and no longer reverts. Characters with Guidance of Theosis ignore part of opponents' DEF when dealing DMG.
